events.title: Isaias strengthens to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season
events.description: Storm expected to make landfall on US’s northern Gulf coast with risk of flash floods and isolated river flooding Isaias has become the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, with wind speeds of 80mph and a minimum pressure of 975mb. It is expected to strengthen to a category 2 hurricane as it approaches the US’s northern Gulf coast on Friday, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). As a result of the strong El Niño , it has been a notably quiet Atlantic hurricane season. The first hurricane of the season has not formed this late since 8 October 1905, which pre-dates the satellite era (1960s) for tracking hurricanes that has allowed for more non-landfall hurricanes to be discovered. events.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs

events.title: Trump's diesel deal with Putin angers Europe
events.description: President Trump's diesel deal with Russia sparks European fury, as Ukraine's President Zelenskyy questions Washington's motives and allies vow to keep pressure on Moscow.

events.title: Cornell suspends frat parties after gang rape case
events.description: Cornell said no parties will be held at frat houses until the end of the academic year. The university is trying to mend its reputation following its handling of a gang rape case in 2024.

events.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial: Former gang leader Duane Davis sentenced to 40 years
events.description: Former Los Angeles gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis was found guilty of ordering the killing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Germany news: Left-leaning Berlin coalition talks break down
events.description: The SPD and Greens in Berlin have halted exploratory coalition talks with the Left Party amid a dispute over Israel policy and antisemitism. DW has more.

events.title: ‘Dark day for Turkey’: Pro-opposition TV channel boss slams police raid, broadcast halt
events.description: Turkish authorities appointed a government trustee to run popular broadcaster Halk TV on Wednesday after police raided its headquarters, halting live broadcasts and arresting 11 people. Halk chairman Cafer Mahirogluin denounced "a dark day for Turkey", adding that seven of his family members were among those detained.

events.title: Trump says 'massive' oil, gas and mineral exploration will begin in 'our' Greenland
events.description: Donald Trump says that preparations are underway to launch a "massive" oil, gas ‌and mineral exploration in Greenland.

events.title: Pope has 'peaceful night' after lung cancer surgery, says Vatican
events.description: The Pope spent a peaceful night in hospital after having surgery to treat lung cancer, the Vatican said.

events.title: Cancer found after Pope had part of his lung removed during 'successful' surgery
events.description: The Pope has undergone surgery to treat lung cancer.

events.title: Formula One to return to Africa for first time in 30 years
